title: Derived extension-by-zero triangle for an etale open cover
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring, X a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and U,V open subschemes covering X. For K in the bounded-below derived category of Λ-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], there exist arrows making jW! (K|W) → jU! (K|U) ⊕ jV! (K|V) → K → jW! (K|W)[1] a distinguished triangle, where W=U∩V and the restriction and extension-by-zero functors are their exact induced derived functors [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Choose any cochain representative of K in the unbounded derived category. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-open-cover-shriek-complex-ses] and the associated distinguished triangle construction for a short exact complex.

The exact-functor comparisons identify the open terms of that triangle with the images of the displayed D+ objects. The inclusion D+→D and the localization preserve biproducts. Fullness lifts the first two maps and, using the shift comparison, the boundary. The fully faithful triangulated inclusion reflects distinguished triangles, so the lifted triangle is distinguished.

theorem exists_distinguished_openCover_lowerShriek
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    ∃ (α : (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (U ⊓ V).ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (U ⊓ V).ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).obj K) ⟶
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).obj K) ⊞
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).obj K))
      (β : (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).obj K) ⊞
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).obj K) ⟶ K)
      (δ : K ⟶
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (U ⊓ V).ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
          (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (U ⊓ V).ι).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).obj K))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk α β δ ∈ distTriang
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
